In addition, it mows down enemies in one go with its enlarged wheels (Killing Cadence).

1032.name: Platinum Sukamon
1032.profile: A po*p-shaped Digimon that shines like platinum. It is a species of Scumon that absorbed the data of minor metals, giving it a luxurious appearance, but its abilities are at the same level as Scumon's. It appears to not have powered-up in any significant way. Its Special Move is flinging metallic, shining po*p at the enemy (Rare Metal Unchi).

1034.name: Plesiomon (X-Antibody)
1034.profile: A previously imaginary Digimon discovered within the computer of a British cryptozoology research institute. It was a Digimon that had already been rumored among researchers. Although it rarely makes an appearance, it seems to show up when visibility is reduced due to being shrouded in fog. It is a mysterious being whose appearance gives the impression of being polished to shine white. It sings with a high-pitched, crystal-clear voice, wrapping the listener in sorrow and making them lose their fighting spirit (Sorrow Blue).    The effect on Plesiomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    According to the latest research analyzed from its high-pitched, crystal-clear cry, it has become clear that most of Plesiomon's configuration data is surprisingly "poetry" data. It has taken on a beautiful, noble yet elegant form, and very rarely appears, causing some researchers to question whether it is related to the legend of a tragic poet who was unable to show themselves to the world after turning into a dragon, and recited poetry about their deepening sorrow. It now releases its "Fantasy Mist", in which it wraps the listener in a fantasy with the melodies it plays using its long barbels. Furthermore, it is said that Plesiomon has another form within this fantasy, but this is unclear.

1035.name: Plotmon
1035.profile: A Holy-species Digimon child characterized by its lop ears. Because it is still very young, it is unable to manifest its holy powers, and isn't even aware of its own mission. For that reason it is naturally insecure, so it can become either good or evil. However, the time will come someday when Plotmon, who was born as a Holy-species Digimon, will awaken to its mission as one of the "Virus Busters". Also, Plotmon is an experimental Digimon that was created by Digimon researchers, and because it was made to imitate the pets that live with humans, it has an appearance close to that of a real animal. With its Special Move "Puppy Howling", a super-high pitched bark, it completely paralyzes the opponent.

1036.name: Plotmon (X-Antibody)
1036.profile: A Holy-species Digimon child characterized by its lop ears. Because it is still very young, it is unable to manifest its holy powers, and isn't even aware of its own mission. For that reason it is naturally insecure, so it can become either good or evil. However, the time will come someday when Plotmon, who was born as a Holy-species Digimon, will awaken to its mission as one of the "Virus Busters". Also, Plotmon is an experimental Digimon that was created by Digimon researchers, and because it was made to imitate the pets that live with humans, it has an appearance close to that of a real animal. With its Special Move "Puppy Howling", a super-high pitched bark, it completely paralyzes the opponent.    The effect on Plotmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Its cuteness as a pet that gives feelings of happiness to those who see it has increased. Not only that, but its holy power has also increased, and after Plotmon walked, it acquired its "Puppy Paw" technique, where it forms a barrier against Virus-types, however, it is unaware of it.

1040.name: Polar Bearmon
1040.profile: An Ice-Snow Digimon that Digimon from snowy areas evolve into by taking in data related to winter sports. It has the ability to create tools made of ice, and typically makes skis and poles to freely slide around snow fields. It enters the dens of Mojyamon and Hyougamon as it skis about, and often causes trouble.    It also uses its ice axe to dig a den, and builds snow huts to secure shelter.    It frequently visits the small snow country of "Thrymheimr", and some individuals have been confirmed to take on the role of constructing homes for other Digimon.    Its Special Moves are turning its gun barrels toward the ground, using them like a jet pack to take off, and slashing the enemy with its skis while performing a spinning kick (Corkscrew Kick), and pouring on a barrage of snowballs from its bazooka with tremendous force (Winter Gunnery).

1042.name: Ponchomon
1042.profile: An Armor-level Ghost Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Purity". Although it is classified as a Ghost-type, it is an unusual Digimon that looks like a Plant-type, judging from its appearance, and it is rumored that when a Togemon has died due to unforeseen circumstances, it will become a Ponchomon. It is said to be a Digimon that was generated from a "Latin music distribution program" that exists on the Network. It looks as if it has a cheerful personality, but its facial expression can't be read, and it is eerie to other Digimon. Because all of its actions are performed with a Latin rhythm, it views Digimon that can't keep up with the beat as its enemies. It seems to get along with Bakemon, who moves to its own music. Its Signature Moves are striking the opponent while getting into a rhythm with the maracas on its Mexican hat (Blood Dance: Maracas Version), and driving punches that only hit the opponent's face with its leather-strapped fists, intoxicating them with its destructive power (Tequila Knuckle).

1046.name: Potamon
1046.profile: A gourmet Digimon that read data on all kinds of fries. As it walks about eating fries, it wants many Digimon to know how delicious they are, and goes around sharing fries that it recommends. It views those who criticize its fries as complainers, and bashes its "Shubashuba Potato", which sends razor-sharp fries flying, and its big, flat, piping hot "Bashed Potato" down from the sky, and lets those who have apologized to it enjoy the splendor of its fries. It is in a competitive relationship with Burgamon over who is better when it comes to fast food.

1047.name: Poyomon
1047.profile: With a translucent body, it is a Digimon Baby that drifts through the "Net Ocean" like a jellyfish. As it has the most primitive structure among the Digimon discovered to date, it has been showered in attention as the "Missing Link", the key to solving the mystery of the origin of Digimon, by the scholars and enthusiasts studying the roots of Digimon. In order to defend itself from intruders it spews potently acidic bubbles out of its mouth.

1048.name: Prairiemon
1048.profile: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". It spends its time burrowing in dry land, and is able to dig underground at a speed of 100 km/h using the large claws on both of its arms. Its nature of behaving in colonies has been confirmed, and although it rarely ever appears on the surface due to its timid personality, it has a habit of sunbathing in groups on fine days with calm weather, so Prairiemon researchers will probably need to read a weather map. When it is assaulted by the enemy and falls into a predicament, it will fight back with its "Sonic Ear", which accelerates the blades on both of its ears to the speed of sound and then slashes the enemy, but more often than not, it will flee by quickly burrowing into the ground.

1049.name: Prince Mamemon
1049.profile: Having taken in data on the Net concerning a royal family, it is a prince of the Mamemon world. Partnering with King Etemon, it plays the part of a mock royal family of the Digital World, and that's why it looks so gorgeous.    Although its personality isn't awful, it was incited by King Etemon and is convinced that it truly is a member of the royal family, and the embarrassing thing is that it considers even the "Royal Knights" to be its subordinates.    Its Special Move is unleashing an intense headbutt without breaking its smile (Smiley Warhead). Despite its appearance, the part that it boasts is its tremendous destructive power, since it is an Ultimate, after all.

1050.name: Prince Mamemon (X-Antibody)
1050.profile: A Digimon that underwent a mutation after reading data on a royal family. The crown and mantle that it wears were reproduced from royal records, so they are very gorgeous. Because of its appearance, it is called the "Prince of the Mamemon World". Its Special Move is headbutting the enemy without breaking its smile (Smiley Warhead).    The effect on Prince Mamemon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    It was reproduced from royal records with greater emphasis in parts. Although there is a rumor that its long legs are the result of its Secret Boots, it is said that its very gorgeous and elegant "Delmo Walking" causes even enemy Digimon to make way for it.

1051.name: Proganomon
1051.profile: A Mineral Digimon with a turtle-like appearance that primarily inhabits desert regions. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. At night, it retracts its hind legs into its shell, and travels long distances by expelling the sand and gravel stored in its body in search of a safe place to sleep.    Most of its shell, which makes up more than half the volume of its body, is comprised of mineral data, so whenever a Proganomon gets erased, only its shell remains like a fossil. Sand-dwelling Digimon sometimes take up residence in the left-behind shell.    Its Special Moves are using its rapidly spinning claws to pulverize the opponent, along with their armor (Tricone Bit Demolisher), and firing the drills on its shell like missiles (Drill Emission).

1054.name: Psychemon
1054.profile: A Digimon characterized by its perturbing, flashy colors. It is said to be a variant of Gabumon. Although it has a personality that is as bright and showy as the colors on its body, it apparently turns cowardly when its fur pelt is removed, just like Gabumon. Its Special Moves are concentrating colorful electrical energy in primary colors, and causing it to explode in range of the enemy (Colorful Spark), and accumulating that same colorful electrical energy in its horn and releasing it (Hadehade Horn). Also, its "Genshoku no Mai", which utilizes the primary colors on its body to perform a peculiar dance, bewildering the enemy, is not something to be taken lightly.

1055.name: Pteranomon
1055.profile: An Armor-level Pterosaur Digimon with wings of steel that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Holding the alias of "Blue Bomber", it can fly at the highest altitudes among aerial Digimon, and it is able to pinpoint bomb the enemy without revealing itself. It has excellent eyesight, and is capable of capturing the enemy's figure even from an altitude of 10 km up in the sky. Since its Special Move "Beak Pierce" is a technique in which it nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, penetrating even armor, regardless of its thickness, and destroying their Digicore with unparalleled accuracy.

1056.name: Pteranomon (X-Antibody)
1056.profile: An Armor-level Pterosaur Digimon with wings of steel that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Holding the alias of "Blue Bomber", it can fly at the highest altitudes among aerial Digimon, and it is able to pinpoint bomb the enemy without revealing itself. It has excellent eyesight, and is capable of capturing the enemy's figure even from an altitude of 10 km up in the sky. Since its Special Move "Beak Pierce" is a technique in which it nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, it penetrates even armor, regardless of its thickness, and destroys their Digicore with unparalleled accuracy.    The effect on Pteranomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Due to fact that there were no Digimon capable of reaching altitudes maintained by Pteranomon up until now, Pteranomon were forced to battle with each other, leading it to possessing air-to-air combat ability and maneuverability. This also meant an improvement in its ability to fly at low altitudes, so it acquired its Special Move "Nail Comb", where it tears the enemy to pieces with the sharp claws on its feet without letting them out of its sight while going at maximum speed at a very low altitude. Also, when it goes at maximum speed, it reduces drag by storing both of its feet within its body.

1057.name: Pteromon
1057.profile: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.    It has a strong interest in other species, and often flies through the sky alongside them in attempt to make contact; this includes Child Digimon such as Piyomon and Falcomon, and occasionally larger Adult and Perfect Digimon. Also, it has the ability to instantly regrow its feathers to heal its wounds when injured.    Its Special Moves are a slash attack where it flaps its arm-wings to send out a blade of wind (Wind Slicer), and piercing the enemy with the talons on its feet while flying (Rumble Claw).

1066.name: Punkmon
1066.profile: A Digimon that evolved by taking in data on music and fashion from punk rock culture. Its personality is aggressive and rebellious, as if embodying the anarchic spirituality of punk rock. It is an anarchist at heart who rarely listens to what others say, and hates being ordered around or being part of a group.    It prefers flashy battles, and will do anything to liven up the atmosphere, such as getting attacked deliberately to show itself off. However, when there is no audience, it cannot get excited, and has a bad habit of losing its temper. During battle, it uses the guitar pick-shaped tip of its tail to strike against the ground or walls, creating a rhythm to hype itself up. The way it opens its mask wide to let out a distinctive roar is the epitome of a punk rocker.    Its Special Moves are sending out jets of flames from the brass knuckles on its hands and then pounding the opponent, branding them with the Digimoji for "PUNK" (Blitzkrieg Bop), and firing a blue flame shot from its mouth (Anarchist Flame).

1067.name: Pupumon
1067.profile: A Slime Digimon which has grown a body as light as a bubble, as well as very thin wings. Its somewhat largish eyes are very sensitive to an object's movement, and if something moves it notices it and immediately springs away, but this does not mean it's a coward, as if it continues to be unkind Pupumon counterattacks. If the opponent approaches, it spits "Doku no Awa" from its mouth to attack.

1068.name: Puroromon
1068.profile: A Larva Digimon which flies freely by individually operating its three pairs of wings. It is not yet powerful, but be that as it may, it is difficult to catch because of its random flying about, which surprisingly gets the opponent completely annoyed. Its Special Move is injecting a tiny quantity of venom with the tiny stinger on its rump (Chikkuritto).

1070.name: Pusumon
1070.profile: A Slime Digimon whose entire body is covered in soft, cotton-like fur; only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are fairly hard. It grows restless without its pacifier, and will cry loudly and incessantly if its pacifier is lost. It is able to expand its body by taking in a deep breath and shoot that inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

1071.name: Pusurimon
1071.profile: A quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spines growing from its back. It is always running around energetically, though it will sometimes appear to stop in its tracks when in reality it has just fallen asleep on the spot. Its Signature Move is causing the fur covering its body to stand and harden, then curling itself into a ball and doing a jump-tackle while spinning (Chikuchiku Rolling).

1072.name: Puttimon
1072.profile: It is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about euphoria, good fortune, and such. Though as a newborn it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back. When it flies about in the sky, it is able to place its opponent in a happy mood with a mysterious powder called "Angel Dust".

1073.name: Puwamon
1073.profile: A Chick Digimon covered in soft feathers. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution will be necessary, since it will shower you down in blinding feathers (Fuwā Feather).

1079.name: Pyramidimon
1079.profile: A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the Digital World. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.    As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies. Since it consumes a lot of energy when active, it often sleeps camouflaging itself as a pyramid.    Even if it suffers heavy damage, it can instantly regenerate by taking in sand from its surroundings, so it is difficult to stop Pyramidimon in its tracks unless one attacks its Digicore directly.    Its Special Moves are spinning its pyramid-shaped fingers and pulverizing the opponent (Zofr Kabus), smashing the opponent from overhead with the pyramids on its shoulders (Apesh Eiqab), and unleashing a sandstorm from the eye on its chest which erodes everything (Laena Khamsin).

1080.name: Qinglongmon
1080.profile: One of the Four Holy Beasts who protect the Digital World, it guards the East and releases intense lightning strikes. It is a legendary being like the other Four Holy Beast Digimon, and its strength is said to equal that of a god. Also, it is counted as one of the Four Great Dragons alongside Holydramon, Goddramon, and Megidramon, and is the most deified existence among them. However, although it is a divine being, it will not easily cooperate with humans and the weak, and it is not likely to lend help to its allies unless there is something serious. Its Special Move is loosing intense thunderbolts from the sky, with divine fury (Sourai).

1081.name: Quantumon
1081.profile: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "Net Ocean", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the Digital World.    Its Special Move is transforming space into a gate via quantum processing, and forcefully sending the enemy into another dimension (Unlimited Journey). This technique can also be used to forcibly evade other Digimon, or send them to another dimension for their own research and analysis. In addition, it can also manipulate the flow of time, causing quantum decay at specific coordinates with its "Hazy Time".

1082.name: Quartzmon
1082.profile: A colossal Digimon that keeps absorbing data to amplify its power. The Great Evil Globe, which makes up most of its body, is a fusion reactor that generates "Gypt Particles", Quartzmon's power source, from the data it has absorbed. Quartzmon's true form is situated at the very top, and can act independently of the Great Evil Globe, and furthermore, it is also capable of altering its appearance. It hungers for the data of the entire world, and will swallow even Digimon whole and absorb them. Its Special Move is emitting the Gypt Particles generated within the Great Evil Globe into its entire surroundings (Gypt Ryūshi Hou), and if you touch them even the slightest bit, they will spread throughout your whole body and completely erase you without leaving any data behind. Also, in its "Ruin Blast", where it injects Gypt Particles into the body of an enemy it seizes with its tentacles, the enemy explodes from within.

1083.name: Queen Chessmon
1083.profile: The strongest Digimon of the Chessmon series which possesses extreme range and offensive ability. It is a reliable being that defends the cowardly King Chessmon. That superior offensive ability is a power that sometimes seems rather inhuman. Its catchphrase is, "God of Chess, bestow pardon!" Its Special Moves are impaling the opponent's vitals with the swords on its armor (Heart Breaker), "Queen Stamp", and "Queen Stick". Also, it can give the opponent a hard time with its "Hime no Wagamama".

1084.name: Queenbeemon
1084.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that is the ruler of the "Royal Base", serving as its "Queen", and also has an ambitious side that seeks the endless expansion of the base. Possessing high scientific and technological prowess, it designed and developed the Royal Base itself.    In addition, it boasts remarkable information processing abilities, such as handling defensive layouts and commanding formations during battle all by itself. On the other hand, its solo combat ability is inferior to Tiger Vespamon's, but it makes up for this with the multitude of functions of its covert honey weapon/throne, the "Royal Throne", which can be considered to be a part of its own body.    It has a conspicuous personality, and never fails to flaunt the fact that it is queen, even within the base. Queenbeemon's Digimon subordinates also revere it as their queen, and while it is being showered with calls of affection on the throne, it routinely waves its covert honey equipment, the "Beam Fan", around, which has absolutely no tactical effect at all.    Its Special Move is producing the most effective poison against its opponent and launching it at them from the Royal Throne's arm unit (Accel Stinger). In its "Hornet Eraser", a beam of light fired from the turret on the underside of the Royal Throne, the barrel is further expanded by being supplied with energy from the Royal Base, boosting its firepower to the point that it can blow a single mountain away.

1088.name: Raguelmon
1088.profile: An Ultimate level Digimon who observes all Angel Digimon with eyes of distrust, in order to prevent the fall of other Angel Digimon. The moment it detects an Angel Digimon that has begun to fall, it will attack and destroy them before they would have fallen completely. However, because it was shunned for its role as an observer, it began to be filled with nihilistic thoughts until its sole line of thought was to reject everything. At that stage, it no longer discerns between friend and foe, turning into a fearsome Digimon that carries out destruction indiscriminately.    Its Special Move is mutilating the enemy using the claws on its arms and the tip of its tail (Form Taranis). Once it impales the enemy, it injects destructive data that eat away at and corrode the enemy from the inside. It can also fire laser bullets from the gemstones situated on its arms and chest (Purhorus).

1095.name: Rapidmon (X-Antibody)
1095.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon that Armor Evolved from Terriermon with the "Digimental of Fate". Rapidmon is normally a Perfect which evolves from Galgomon, but thanks to the "Digimental of Fate", it is able to shine gold and sublimate power up to the Ultimate Level. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back (Rapid Fire), and "Golden Triangle", which is similar in power level to Magnamon's Special Move, "Extreme Jihad".    The effect on Rapidmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    The power contained within the Digimental of Fate has been drawn out even further by the X-Antibody, and it is now capable of constantly exhibiting power at the Ultimate Level. The armaments on both of its arms and back form the "Armed Arms"; it rapid-fires its "Rapid Blaster", which has a low attenuation rate, at long-range, and its "Laser Gatling Arm", where it switches from the Armed Arms on its back, at close-to-mid-range. In addition, a booster function has also been added, allowing it to dive into the enemy's chest at high speed, and slash them with its claws.    Its greatest Special Move is detaching all of the Armed Arms, cornering the enemy by operating them remotely, and shooting them up with a billion bullets (Billion Bullet).

1098.name: Raptor Sparrowmon
1098.profile: An evolution of Sparrowmon whose entire body has become clad in armor made from Chrome Digizoid. Its Chrome Digizoid armor eliminated its weakness, the inability to take hits, and its flexible wings have given it the ability to make sharp turns at high speed. While it excels in tactics such as hit-and-run and disrupting the battlefield, its temperamental personality still remains and it often makes blunders.Its Special Move is "Raptor Grapple", an improved version of "Crash Boom" where it ensnares the opponent and slams them down from high up in the sky. It also has a technique, "Crash Charge", where it charges forth and capitalizes on its Chrome Digizoid armor.

1105.name: Rasielmon
1105.profile: An Ophan Digimon that was once appointed to the same rank as Ofanimon. It possesses the mysterious power to foresee everything in the world from the "Kernel" (God's domain). It is said that it knows all about events throughout the Digital World, and has gained a divine amount of knowledge with that power.    Its Special Moves are freely combining the five elements from the magic circles on its arms and releasing enormous energy (Knowledge Stream). And, as for its "Sefer Raziel", which brings about all kinds of miracles to exterminate the adversary, not even Rasielmon itself knows what will happen.

1110.name: Red Vegimon
1110.profile: A strengthened version of Vegimon whose entire body has ripened and turned red. It has high intelligence and offensive ability, unlike Vegimon, who is still unripe. This red, ripened form is Vegimon's true form, and it is possible that the harsher environments found on the Folder Continent caused Vegimon to take on this original form. Its personality has turned even more devious and cunning. Its Special Move is a spewing out its putrid, poison-laced breath (Hazard Breath). Anyone who carelessly tries to take it on, mistaking it for an ordinary Vegimon, will no doubt meet a terrible fate.

1116.name: Renamon (X-Antibody)
1116.profile: A Beast Man Digimon with the appearance of a golden fox. Renamon is a Digimon whose relationship with humans is directly apparent; it is said that depending on how it was raised during its time as a Baby, it can evolve into a Renamon of particularly high intelligence. It is always calm, cool, and collected, as well as disciplined enough not to lose that composure in any situation. Its slender, tall appearance stands out when compared with other Childs, and rather than emphasizing on power in battle, it instead makes sport of the enemy with various techniques that utilise its speed. Its Signature Move is a transformation art in which it copies the opponent's appearance and re-covers itself in that texture (Kohenkyo). Its Special Move is throwing sharpened leaves at the opponent (Koyousetsu).    The effect on Renamon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Cloaked in an overflowing, bewitching aura, it is a dignified Onmyoji that is well-versed in the dark arts, especially for a Child. Its additional large tail as well as the red patterns that have emerged all over its body are symbols of its increased strength. The techniques it uses have been further improved as well, and it controls the battlefield cunningly with its "Taikyokusen", in which it fires a spinning yin-yang slash to tear the enemy to pieces, and "Kochōgen", where it re-covers not only its own texture but also that of its surroundings, inviting the enemy into a world of illusions.

1119.name: Revolmon
1119.profile: A mutated Digimon whose body has become a gun barrel. Although the details of how it was born are completely unclear, it has a deep sense of justice and acts as a "Virus Buster". The "Virus Busters" exterminate the spirit of "Evil" possessed even among Vaccines and especially by Viruses, and are Digimon who have the ability to Delete. Also, it has another side that loves gambling, and since it really loves Russian roulette, it is likely to overlook even a Virus Digimon if it can get through Russian roulette, and is unable to hate them for a little while. Its Special Move is personally becoming a gun barrel and firing off a bullet of justice (Justice Bullet).

1122.name: Rhinomon (X-Antibody)
1122.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Miracles". It is clad in armor made of Chrome Digizoid, and this armor cannot be destroyed even by laser-based attacks, let alone physical attacks, owing to its reflective surface in addition to its bulky fortification. Also, despite its sluggish appearance, because it moves its body using its excess power, its movement speed can even be said to be unusually fast for something its size. Its Special Move is cloaking itself in a barrier made of light emitted from the "Ain Soph Aur" jewels embedded in its armor, then charging into the enemy (Atomic Burst). Digimon on the receiving end of this technique are disintegrated into digital data composed of "0"s and "1"s, the smallest units of data, and never return to their original state.    The effect on Rhinomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Its armor has been polished even further, not only raising its defense but also, more importantly, completely changing its attack pattern to become more aggressive. Most prominently, its horn has been transformed into a sword, which it uses for various attacks such as to impale enemies it charges towards and disintegrate their data (Atomic Blade), and to split enemies into two with a large swing of its head (Split Burst). Its personality has also changed to become more hostile, and it will boldly challenge any Digimon it deems powerful to a duel.

1123.name: Rinkmon
1123.profile: An Armor-level Mutant Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". It is a Cyborg Digimon created from the sample data of an experiment where elementary particles were accelerated to the speed of light in an accelerator. It is said to have been born from the fusion of that sample data, a Digimon raised for experimental use, and the Digimental. A very keen Digimon, it can accelerate up to 98 percent of the speed of light, so there are no Digimon who can rival Rinkmon with their speed. However, because its power is weak in contrast to its outstanding speed, its fighting and hand-to-hand combat have a weak side to them. Its Special Move, "Spinning Cutter" rapidly spins its body using its prided speed, and tears up the enemy with the cutters on both of its arms.

1125.name: Rize Greymon (X-Antibody)
1125.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that has mechanized over half of its body. In spite of its large build, it flies to the sky to attack the enemy. The offensive power of the shots fired from the gigantic revolver on its left arm is said to rival that of a single nuclear warhead, and it is normally impossible to rapid-fire due to its tremendous power and recoil. In order to withstand that power, its gun barrel is made from Chrome Digizoid. Its Special Moves are a high-speed rapid-firing at the limit of the Chrome Digizoid's endurance (three-round bursts) (Trident Revolver), and firing a beam barrage from its chest-cannon and the three beam cannons extending from its wings (Rising Destroyer). Also, its "Solid Strike", in which it charges at the opponent and knocks them out with its gigantic revolver, has extraordinary impact strength.    The effect on Rize Greymon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    The Crest of the Sun shines and overflows with so much energy that it spurts out from all over its body. The claws on its hands and feet have become beam blades that utilize that energy, and it can quickly use them in close combat. Also, its Trident Revolver has transformed into a gunblade, and its slash technique "Zan Thrust" has extraordinary sharpness. Its Special Move is charging its energy to the maximum, and firing it from the Trident Revolver (Sunrise Buster).

1126.name: Rook Chessmon (Black)
1126.profile: A Digimon which has an appearance like a fortress which boasts impregnable defense. Although it's a gigantic Digimon it is very fast, and it defends against the opponent's strikes, then attacks. Its catchphrase is, "The opponent is nothing after me!" Its Special Moves are charging the opponent as it stands at attention, mowing them down and destroying them (Stronghold), and firing from the gunports on its arms (Rook Gatling). Also, it can use a stubborn, immovable, steadfast defense (Castle Wall).

1129.name: Rosemon (X-Antibody)
1129.profile: A Fairy Digimon which has an appearance like the rose, which is called the Queen of Flowers. It has the form of a beautiful woman, and desires to remain beautiful forever. Its personality is more or less that way, and though it is excessively self-conscious about such things, its true strength does not in fact compare unfavorably with other Ultimates. Also, it wears on its breast a "Tiferet", a jewel which is engraved with the symbol of love and beauty. This Tiferet that it possesses is said to promise it eternal beauty and power. Its Special Move is taming Digimon, no matter how frenzied, with a thorned whip charged with electricity (Thorn Whip). It is said that those that suffer this technique become Rosemon's slave, body and soul.    The effect on Rosemon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Rosemon's vivid beauty has been drawn out, and its appearance, dyed a crimson so deep that it makes all other red objects look completely washed out, even gives an overwhelming sense of inferiority to those who see it. The "Aphroditear" droplets on its petals seen when incurring the wrath of Rosemon are said to be the tears of its love, and Digimon that lay their eyes on them are eventually annihilated by its Special Move "Rosen Blood", in which they personally embrace Rosemon's thorned whips despite knowing that they will get injured, taking damage.

1132.name: Runnermon
1132.profile: A Beast Digimon that evolved via the data from a treadmill. It is capable of running without any loss in speed even through areas with poor footing such as mountainous areas or swamplands. However, rather than its speed or ability to cover distances, its stamina deserves special mention; it is able to continue running for long periods while maintaining its top speed the entire time.    Its Special Moves are charging at the enemy at super speed from their blind spot (Lightning Rush), and shooting energy blades from its tail that slice enemies apart (Heartbeat Impulse).

1135.name: Ryugumon
1135.profile: A Digimon with a beautiful appearance that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World. It constantly emits a faint light from its translucent body, charming those who see it.    Not only does it have a beautiful appearance, but also extremely high combat ability. It is revered as the lord of Ryūshōgu as well as its guardian deity, and the peace in this area, which is also known as a paradise for water-dwelling Digimon, has been brought about thanks to Ryugumon.    It possesses both high intelligence and a calm disposition, and although it has a nature that despises conflict, it will wield its mysterious power to the fullest to counter against those who cause harm to Ryūshōgu. It has the ability to absorb energy through the cerata on its tail, and at other times, share that energy with others, and also has the role of purifying Ryūshōgu to its normal state.    Its Special Moves are raising only the water pressure in the enemy's surroundings and crushing them to death (Nirai Shikaishō), and firing a laser from its brow (Wadatsumi no Harae).

1139.name: Sagomon
1139.profile: A Demon Man Digimon that was banished from the Digital World's heaven, and fell to the backwoods of North Bridge Island. Although it usually has a cheerful, joke-cracking personality, if it touches the skulls wrapped around its waist it goes into a fury like a raging fire. That is because if even one of the nine skulls wrapped around its waist is lost it will be transformed into a terrifying Digimon. It possesses the "Kouyouhoujou" staff which demonstrates terrifying destructive power in the super-heavyweight class, it spins it freely to raise a waterspout (Kouyouhoujou: Kamon no Jin), and strikes the ground with its staff to shatter it and release a raging current (Kouyouhoujou: Taki no Jin). Also, for close combat it can stab with the crescent-moon shaped blade (Getsugazan). It is troubled by worrying, "What am I?", so it went on a journey to discover the answer.

1145.name: Salamandamon
1145.profile: An Amphibian Digimon that "Armor Evolved" with the "Digimental of Courage". It is as carefree as it looks with its flame-clad, salamander-like appearance, but once angered, it will cause the flames covering its body to flare up even more and attack. Its Signature Move is spewing out scorching-hot flames from its mouth (Heat Breath). Its Special Move is gathering oxygen in the air and triggering a violent explosion (Backdraft).

1146.name: Sand Yanmamon
1146.profile: A species of Yanmamon that lives in the desert. Unlike Yanmamon, it has a carefree personality, but is merciless against Digimon that enter its territory. Its Special Move is generating a small sandstorm by flapping its wings intensely (Desert Wind).

1151.name: Sanzomon
1151.profile: A Monk Digimon that is journeying around the Digital World in order to achieve enlightenment. It overcomes many difficult ordeals, and as training it imposes asceticism on its own body, day and night. Although Sanzomon doesn't carry any weapons at all, it unleashes various techniques by reciting sutras. It brings the hearts of wild Digimon back to their senses by making them listen to endless words of gratitude (To Shishun-kyou). Sanzomon manifests the ordeals that it has suffered and showers them on the opponent (Kochou Mu-kyou). It displays an illusion that its scattered rosary beads are endlessly attacking from all directions in order to crush their spirit (Mugen Danmaku Shin-kyou), and so forth. The purified energy necessary to achieve enlightenment is accumulated in Sanzomon's Digicore, and it's rumored that if you steal this then you will be released from every injury or terminal disease and acquire immortality, which draws in Digimon that are impelled by greed, and those chasing after it are numerous. However, enemies are not the only ones who are drawn to Sanzomon, as there are also troubled Digimon with their own various issues. It is said that among those, there are also Digimon searching for answers and truth that adore Sanzomon and journey along with it.

1156.name: Seadramon (X-Antibody)
1156.profile: Inhabiting the intensely competitive Net Ocean since ancient times, it is thought to be an Aquatic Digimon that evolved more drastically by continuing to battle. Characterized by its long, serpentine body, it uses its long body to wreath itself around enemies that are coming to attack, and constricts until the enemy suffocates. Naturally, it doesn't have intelligence or speech, and it swims around the Net Ocean leisurely according to its instincts. Its Special Move is breathing absolute zero air out of its mouth, instantly freezing water and firing it at the opponent (Ice Arrow).    The effect on Seadramon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Its body has been specialized solely for swimming quicker underwater, and its sense of smell underwater has developed further. Although it does not approach anyone bigger than itself, it sniffs out injured Digimon far off in the distance and attacks them. Rather than its intelligence, its instincts, which it acquired through its struggle to survive, appear strongly. Its Special Move is an enhanced version of "Ice Arrow" in which it continuously fires it, piercing the opponent (Ice Spear).

1157.name: Seahomon
1157.profile: An Armor-level Aquatic Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Light". It inhabits places with high water pressure in the deepest trenches of the Net Ocean, so it has a small build, but when it rises up to an area of the ocean with shallow water, it seems that it becomes even larger than Seadramon-species Digimon. Although it is still a hypothesis, it is rumored that Seahomon is a survivor of ancient Digimon said to have perished in the past, and that it might have something to do with Seadramon-species Digimon. Its Special Move is spewing out a seven-colored beam from its trumpet-like mouth (Prism Rainbow). This technique has the effect of purifying all feelings of conflict such as the enemy's belligerence and hatred.

1159.name: Searchmon
1159.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". It has "inquisitive" habits due to the effects of the "Digimental of Knowledge", and it performs information gathering and reconnaissance with the radome (radar) attached to its back. Searchmon can detect the presence of enemies no matter how small their sounds or vibrations are, and also gathers information on them. Its Special Move is emitting radio waves that derange the opponent from the radome on its back, leaving them in a state of complete confusion (Jamming Hertz).

1161.name: Sepikmon
1161.profile: An Armor-level Demon Man Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". Due to the power of its strange mask, it is able to speak with the spirits of the dead. It usually lurks in the depths of the Digital World's jungles, and rarely ever appears before others. According to one theory, it is said that Sepikmon never leaves the jungle because the spirits of the dead are its only friends and that it has no living ones. If you hear voices speaking as though they were conversing, despite no one being there, in the Digital World's jungles, you'd better leave without doing anything. Otherwise, you might end up being one of Sepikmon's friends. Its Special Move is a cursed weapon that contains the spirits of the dead (Spirit Boomerang). It makes sport of the enemy with its ever-changing trajectory.

1163.name: Sethmon
1163.profile: An Armor-level Demon Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Because the power of the Digimental of Love was too great, it was unable to control it, and so it was converted into the power of hatred. Its body is colored a baleful red, and it has the power to create calamitous storms. As it is the polar opposite of Holsmon, it is thought that they are the embodiments of the duality of love and hatred possessed by the "Digimental of Love". Its Special Moves are a hot wind that rages in the desert (Heat Storm), and striking with its two gigantic tusks (Tusk Driver).

1165.name: Shademon
1165.profile: A Digimon with no substance that haunts the shadows of humans and Digimon. It feeds on the despair of the haunted opponent and transforms it into its own nourishment, and it is said that which fiendish Digimon it evolves to varies by the amount ingested. Its Special Moves are continuously displaying illusions of being knocked to the ground 10000 times (Free Death Fall), and manipulating the surrounding Digimon to assault the enemy who is being haunted (Kill Me).

1168.name: Shagaramon
1168.profile: A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryūshōgu, an oceanic area in the eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryūshōgu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.    Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryūshōgu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryūshōgu by Ryugumon. The Digimon responsible for gatekeeping alongside it include Hangyomon and Mermaimon, and Shagaramon has the additional role of supervising the other gatekeepers.    It also has the ability to fly in the air, and can occasionally be seen soaring gracefully through the skies above Ryūshōgu's waters.    Its Special Moves are creating a huge wave-like fan and hurling it at the opponent (Rōtō Sen), and detonating small spheres of compressed seawater (Kankai Sakusōjin). Finally, its "Sōten Ryūjinga" devours the opponent with a dragon made from seawater.

1171.name: Shakomon
1171.profile: A Digimon shaped like a bivalve covered by a hard shell. Because its shell developed rapidly, its inner structure has become slime-shaped like that of a Baby. It is a cunning fellow who lures the opponent with its cute face, and attacks them once they get close. Also, when its shell is closed, it has such high defense as to easily deflect things such as light attacks. Its Special Moves are shooting jadeite formed within its body at the opponent (Black Pearl), and hitting the opponent with a high-pressure water current (Water Screw).

1172.name: Shakomon (X-Antibody)
1172.profile: A Digimon shaped like a bivalve covered by a hard shell. Because its shell developed rapidly, its inner structure has become slime-shaped like that of a Baby. It is a cunning fellow who lures the opponent with its cute face, and attacks them once they get close. Also, when its shell is closed, it has such high defense as to easily deflect things such as light attacks. Its Special Moves are shooting jadeite formed within its body at the opponent (Black Pearl).    The effect on Shakomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Its bivalve shell has further developed, and contrary to the beautiful cherry-pink pattern on its shell, it is equipped with underwater jet ports to quickly escape after attacking approaching enemies. Also, even if you avoid its Special Move "Black Pearl", it will take you by surprise and fire its hidden pistol "Black Derringer", so it has started doing things that are even more cunning. It appears to have been made by gathering up junk parts from the depths of the Net Ocean, and can fire two shots of very small jadeite, but they are not very powerful.

1173.name: Shamamon
1173.profile: A Goburimon whose duty is to listen to the will of God, and convey that to its clan. It performs a mysterious dance during its rituals, and it is said that once it gets fired up to the maximum, it becomes able to hear the prophecies of God. It also makes use of this ritual to predict matters that are of importance to its clan. Its Special Move is striking the enemy's head with the large club it uses for its rituals (Shama Hammer).

1174.name: Shawujinmon
1174.profile: A Demon Man Digimon banished from the Digital World's heaven. Although it is a calm and collected Digimon, it is said that a certain Digicore was sealed among the nine beads of its necklace, and if even one bead is lost it will be transformed once again into a terrifying Digimon. Its Special Moves are raising a waterspout by freely spinning its astonishing super-heavyweight class "Kouyoujou" staff (Kouyoujou: Kamon no Jin), and striking the ground with its staff to shatter it and release a raging current (Kouyoujou: Taki no Jin). Also, for close combat it can stab with the crescent-moon shaped blade (Getsugazan).

1175.name: Sheepmon
1175.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". The surface of its body is covered in wool of the finest quality. Also, Sheepmon is very sluggish, so just watching them move in flocks will cause you to sleep. The equipment on its back is a booster/bazooka unit called the "Wool Ball Booster", and with this, it reproduces the low-speed movement characteristic of Sheepmon. Its Special Move is forcibly putting enemy Digimon to sleep during any battle with giant balls of wool launched from the "Wool Ball Booster" (Wool Grenade).

1177.name: Shima Unimon
1177.profile: A subspecies of Unimon that has stripes all over its body. Because the data of the Unicorn is more highly expressed in its body, it lacks the wings of the Pegasus. For that reason, it is unable to fly in the air, but it races across the land with its powerful legs. Also, its Unicorn horn is sharper than Unimon's, and its lethal potential has increased. Its Special Move is spewing a shock wave from its gigantic mouth (Raster Shot).

1181.name: Shine Greymon(Ruin Mode)
1181.profile: A form of Shine Greymon that unleashed its power through hatred when its comrades were defeated and its pride wounded. Its thirst for unlimited power has transformed its originally "positive" solar energy into "negative" dark energy. Its Special Moves have all been drastically enhanced by dark energy as well. However, if it draws out dark energy beyond its limits during battle, it will risk turning into a Digitama.

1182.name: Shivamon
1182.profile: An Ultimate Digimon that evolved by achieving enlightenment through yoga. It is a pursuer of peace that possesses both a gentle heart and the rigor of trying to guide others. It shows its violent disposition to those who lack decorum or disturb the peace, and annihilates them without mercy. The energy concealed within its body is as powerful as nuclear fuel, and it is a god of destruction that pulverizes everything when push comes to shove.    Its Special Moves are firing unparalleled, orb-shaped light energy from its palms (Kūṭastha Kiraṇa), and hurling the rings on its arms, whose shape it can change at will, to blow the enemy away (Kamala Karma). Also, its "Samādhi Śānti", a rainbow-colored barrier it covers itself with in its yoga poses, does not let most attacks pass through, and this barrier can only be penetrated by those who have acquired strength through the power of yoga, like Shivamon.

1183.name: Shoemon
1183.profile: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies. The sole of its shoe has a very strong grip, allowing it to move smoothly over any rough road, and climb even vertical walls and pillars with ease as well. Since it prefers cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.    Sweet fruits are its favorite food, and when the sole of its shoe opens like jaws, it heartily bites into and eats fruits along with their tough skins.    Its Special Moves are a two-step attack where it jumps high while detaching the sole of its shoe from its main body (Wonder Stomp), and stitching the opponent up with a large amount of sewing needles it spits out of its mouth, preventing them from moving (Petit Needle). These sewing needles, with the thread attached, are also used when traveling to distant locations.

1184.name: Shoeshoemon
1184.profile: An agile Puppet Digimon that travels as if it is gliding through treetops on roller skates. It moves around restlessly, and dislikes staying still.    Its cheek pouches, where it usually keeps its food in, have a larger capacity than they look, and it can also place important items besides food in them to carry around. In addition, if they won't fit in its cheek pouches, it forces them between the gaps in its tail or inside the zipper on its abdomen. Because it has a habit of collecting things as well as stealing things, it will occasionally snatch food from other Digimon while passing by them.    Its Special Moves are "Rolling Stomper", in which it presses down on the rapidly-spinning tires of its roller skates, and its "Donguri Bomb", where it throws an acorn-shaped bomb taken out of the zipper on its abdomen, causes a large amount of acorns to fly off along with an explosion, dealing damage over a vast area.

1185.name: Shonitamon
1185.profile: The "Armed-reconnaissance Mode" born from two Digimon's overflowing curiosity. It specializes in methods of concealing its appearance, freely uses ninjutsu to penetrate enemy territory, and can transmit the enemy info it has accumulated to its allies with Monitamon's "Information Sharing" ability, and is able to withdraw whenever it likes without being noticed...however, although it has this potential, for some mysterious and specific reason, it is never seen exhibiting this ability. Because its curiosity easily gets the best of it, it frequently sneaks into areas differing from its objective, and performs the wrong armed reconnaissance against its better judgment. In particular, there are many eyewitness reports of it at hot springs or pools. It insists that it is a "scout", not a "voyeur".

1186.name: Shooting Starmon
1186.profile: The Jogress-evolved form of Starmon and the Pickmons. A horde of Pickmons surround Starmon and their thoughts become one, allowing Starmon to ascend to a Super Major-type.    Its Special Move is attacking by turning into a flaming star that penetrates the atmosphere (Astro Bomber), with such force that it creates a huge crater upon impact. Not only that, it is able to rekindle the weakened hearts of depressed, dispirited Digimon by shouting passionate phrases at them (Dynamite Soul). Its "Ryūsei Rock Damashī", a Combined Special Move with Shoutmon EX6, is a straight right punch filled with fighting spirit.

1187.name: Shootmon
1187.profile: A Machine Digimon that evolved via the data of various ball games from around the world. With a cannon in one hand capable of shooting all kinds of balls, it plans to popularize ball games throughout the Digital World. Shootmon is nicknamed the "Laughing Oni Coach" by Digimon that fear it because it approaches them with a smiling face that never changes whether it is angry or happy.    Its Special Moves are shooting balls from its cannon at speeds exceeding 300 km/h (Cannonball Shooter), and charging into the enemy by capitalizing on its elastic, spring-like legs (Wild Pitch). Also, Digimon who suffer its "Round Jail", where it turns anything it touches into a ball without wasting its breath, are mercilessly shot out of its cannon.

1188.name: Shortmon
1188.profile: A Food Digimon shaped like a shortcake that aims to be a first-class pâtissier. It studies every day to polish its skills due to the cake data that flows into the Digital World. It has also learned how to treat customers politely, and dreams of opening its own cake shop someday and serving delicious cakes to customers.    If a Digimon that ruins the space where it is enjoying cakes appears, it will drive them away with its "Tastone", in which it pierces the enemy with a large fork, and "Sweet Berry", in which it shoots the strawberry on its head.

1192.name: Shoutmon (Dorulu Cannon)
1192.profile: Dorulumon's "Bombardment Mode". It is Dorulumon's greatest Special Move, condensing and firing all the energy that it possesses. Because Dorulumon must concentrate on charging the energy, the cooperation of another Digimon to take charge of sighting is essential in order to hit the target. Also, while charging the energy, Dorulumon's defensive power goes down to zero, leaving it completely defenseless. It becomes absolutely essential at this time to have the other Digimon's aid in guarding it, and it can be said that this bold move can only be used when it has absolute trust in its partner.

1193.name: Shoutmon (Jet Sparrow)
1193.profile: Sparrowmon's "Machspeed-cruiser Mode" that acquired even more speed.    It possesses tremendous thrust and is able to carry other Digimon on its back while flying, but if that Digimon doesn't have a lot of will-power, it will be immediately blown off by the excess wind speed.    There is an instrument called a DigiCompressor within its body, which produces thrust by taking in air, super-compressing it, then exhausting it out its aft. This instrument can be used not only for flight but also for offensive techniques, and its "Plasma Blaster", in which it super-compresses air to the point that it becomes plasma, then shoots it out its gunports, is Jet Sparrow's greatest Special Move. In addition, it has "Air Shooter", in which it shoots compressed air with a roar. Because "Air Shooter" has a significant spreading factor, its efficacy is low against distant opponents, but if the opponent is close by it has the power to instantaneously blow them away.

1194.name: Shoutmon (King Ver.)
1194.profile: A Shoutmon with a valiant air, and a yellow scarf that flutters in the wind. Its strength has increased drastically as a result of its training, and its performances, in which it uses its McField-brand mic, shine especially bright.    Its Special Moves are facing its mic and letting out a passionate, maximum volume shout (Soul Crusher), putting on a polished mic performance and unleashing its bōjutsu techniques (Rowdy Rocker), and hurling a passionate fireball containing its heart and soul (Rock Damashī), all of which have been powered-up.

1195.name: Shoutmon (Star Sword)
1195.profile: Starmon and the Pickmons' "Sword-union Mode". The saw-shaped blade is strong and boasts peerless firmness, so that it shreds the opponent when it cuts through them, inflicting massive damage. Because the wounds are completely ragged, it takes time for the opponent to recover from the damage of an ordinary attack, and they incur even greater damage.    Also, because the united Pickmon can shift freely, it possesses not only firmness, but also a flexibility that allows it to bend like a willow branch and absorb impacts that are too strong.    It can be said that the Star Sword has an appearance which embodies the strong ties of Starmon and the Pickmons' emotional bond.

1198.name: Shoutmon EX6
1198.profile: Shoutmon EX6 which has become the "Evolution Mode". It is formed from the DigiXros of evolved Digimon that included Omega Shoutmon, and it is considered to surpass Shoutmon X7 in defensive and flying ability because its body and wings shine gold and silver. The "Demolition Horn" on its left arm destroys any armor in addition to super-oscillating the instant it pierces it. Also, its right arm is equipped with the "Sol Calibur" sword. When Shooting Starmon is present, it unleashes a blow from its fist heavy enough to shatter a star using their Combined Special Move "Ryūsei Rock Damashī".

1200.name: Shoutmon X2
1200.profile: The "Enhanced-armor Mode" of Ballistamon, who excels in defense, confers physical strength and defense several times over to that Digimon by housing another Digimon within, and furthermore, as a result of fusing the latent abilities of these two Digimon, it brings out many powerful Special Moves.    Its Special Moves are full of variety, with close-combat attacks, beam attacks, and live ammunition attacks, and have the range to cope with anything from one-on-one combat to group battles, so its might draws more than enough from Ballistamon's latent abilities. In particular, it can be said that its "Horn Breaker DX", an enhancement on Ballistamon's "Horn Breaker", is a vital technique, breaking into the enemy lines by hovering and sends opponents flying, opening a breach. Also, its "Buddy Blaster", which it can only use when it synchronizes the power of friendship between the two Digimon, is its greatest Special Move, converting its emotional strength to energy and shooting it from its horn.

1203.name: Shoutmon X3
1203.profile: A warrior called the "Physical Mode", born from three Digimon's combat instinct and possessing the fundamental abilities of "Spirit, Skill, and Power" in great supply.    Its motion is rich with maneuverability, and it makes sport of the enemy with its acrobatic movements. It appears slender and because its flexible body joints absorb and dissipate the force they receive, it possesses the ability to resist impacts.    The "V" on its chest can not only fire its "Three Victorize", which sweeps away hordes of opponents in a single strike, but can also be detached and used as the gigantic boomerang "Victorize Boomerang", instead of as a sword, as it is an all-purpose weapon that can even be thrown.

1207.name: Shoutmon X4B
1207.profile: The "Divine-horse Mode" formed when Beelzebumon granted further power to the "Victory Mode" which incarnated from four Digimon. It is a speedy knight who, if it wonders whether it can run across the land like a swift horse, will gallop to the heavens as if it was sprinting. Because Beelzebumon's power has added to the power of the "Victory Mode", each of its techniques has been boosted exponentially. In particular, its "Chaos Flare", based on Beelzebumon's Special Move "Death the Cannon", has been empowered to the point that it can pierce through mountain ranges. The appearance of it releasing its "Star's Blade Celestrike", in which it destroys the opponent with a hail of bullets as it sprints at them, then cuts them right in half, makes it appropriate to now call it a fierce god.

1208.name: Shoutmon X4K
1208.profile: The "Knight Mode" in which Knightmon and the Pawn Chessmons granted impregnable defensive power and offensive power to the "Victory Mode" which incarnated from four Digimon. It wears a cape depicting the Crest symbolizing hope, and is equipped with a greatsword which combines Knightmon's "Berserk Sword" with the Star Sword, and a shield designed after the "Xros Heart" army logo.    Its Special Move "Burning Star Crusher" has increased in temperature and sharpness, and is capable of slashing many enemies with a single stroke.

1210.name: Shoutmon X5
1210.profile: The "Finalist Mode", born when the hearts of five Digimon came together. It is a form of the "Victory Mode", who primarily specializes in ground battles, that obtained the power of flight as the ultimate power-up. Its "Meteor Buster Attack", in which it runs up to the stratosphere, then becomes a meteorite and rams into the opponent, carves out a giant crater in not just the opponent, but also in the land around them for several hundred meters. Also, its "Meteor Impact", in which it concentrates all of its energy into its arm, then releases it as it rams into the opponent from close range, is a Special Move that reliably brings down the opponent.

1212.name: Shoutmon X5B
1212.profile: The "Pegasus-wargod Mode" formed when Beelzebumon granted further power to Shoutmon X5, which incarnated from five Digimon. Beelzebumon's firepower has added to the full power of Shoutmon X5, who boasts of being unmatched either on land or in the air, boosting its fighting strength exponentially.    Its "Burst Dash Stream", a series of Special Moves in which it cuts the opponent to pieces with "Burning Star Crusher", launches them with "Meteor Impact", and finishes them off with "Chaos Flare", pours raging waves of bold moves on the opponent in a flash with a three-step wave of attacks. This Pegasus becomes a galloping comet across the sky and makes sport of any kind of opponent with its godlike speed, and with its power, which should surely be praised as divine skill, it is like a wargod sent from heaven to destroy demons.

1216.name: Shoutmon X7(Superior Mode)
1216.profile: The "Awaking Mode" that Shoutmon X7 powers up into by turning several desires for peace into strength. The radiance of the aura overflowing from its Gold Digizoid has increased further, and it possesses wings of holy light. While carrying all hopes on its shoulders, it fights evil in order to guide the Digital World to peace, concentrating its passionate heart into the Burning Rocker.    Its Special Move is slashing its McField-brand mic, which has been transformed into a greatsword by concentrating energy, downward from overhead (Final Xros Blade). A single stroke of its sword leaves Digimon that possess a heart of justice unharmed, but as for Digimon with an evil heart, it completely resets their data, and it is said that they forcibly degenerate into a Digitama.

1217.name: Shroudmon
1217.profile: A Demon Man Digimon that evolved when a certain Digimon tempered its body beyond its limit during unimaginable training. As a result of it just fighting repeatedly like an Asura, it came to be known as the "Fierce God". Its mind is already broken, and it has even forgotten the reason why it sought strength. It is a genuine combat enthusiast who loves fist fighting, and forces its defeated opponents to get back up.    Its Special Moves are using its iron fists, shrouded in an ominous aura, to dish out a combo attack too quick for the eye to see (Kishungouken), and reducing its surroundings to ashes with a roundhouse kick covered in flames (Gokuen Hakaishū). Its "Garaien Saiha", in which it fires black flaming energy shots from its held-out palms, boasts the single greatest firepower generated by a Digimon.

1221.name: Siesamon (X-Antibody)
1221.profile: A Digimon which has the appearance of the legendary holy beast, the "Siisaa". It has the power to sweep away calamity, and exhibits tremendous power toward evildoers. It is an ally to those that are kind-hearted, and will try to protect its Tamer from every calamity, even if it has to sacrifice its own body. Contrary to its heroic appearance, it usually basks leisurely in the sunlight, due to its docile personality. However, the sunlight is an important factor for Siesamon, because it charges its life energy. Its Signature Move "Sekkantou" temporarily prevents the intrusion of evil Viruses, as a kind of Firewall. Its Special Move is firing countless holy arrows of sunlight (Tiida Ija).    The effect on Siesamon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    It is clad in golden armor that shines more the longer it basks in the sunlight, forming a barrier that repels attacks from Demon-species Digimon. It seems that you can tell how long it has been charging for based on how red its tail is. Siesamon is sunbathing leisurely even now, preparing for battle against evil Digimon. Its Special Move is turning into a ball of light and charging at evil (Koryūkyū).

1226.name: Sistermon Blanc
1226.profile: A girl-shaped Digimon that looks like it's wearing a white rabbit, and whose elder sister is Sistermon Noir. In contrast to its elder sister Noir, it is slightly introverted, and it almost always hides behind its elder sister. It is caring for Hackmon just like its elder sister, and also acts as its escort. Although it is trying to diligently carry out Gankoomon's request and assist in training with Hackmon, it frequently ends up reining in its elder sister's violent manner. In order to repay Gankoomon for saving it and its elder sister, it puts all of its effort into being a chaperone for Hackmon. The triple-pronged "Cross Barbée" lance that it carries as a weapon has both the offensive side of its "Divine Pierce", which pierces the opponent, and the defensive side that guards itself using the "Protect Wave" that it generates by stabbing the butt end into the ground. Furthermore, it has "Grand Sister Cruz", a coordinated technique with its elder sister.

1227.name: Sistermon Blanc (Awake)
1227.profile: Another form of Sistermon Blanc. The Holy Stigma appears at the center of the wimple on its head, and it awakens. Its reserved personality completely changes upon entering this state, rushing about the battlefield with frenzied movements obeying its battle instincts laid bare. When it reverts from its awakened state, it instantly falls into a gentle sleep, making its previous violence seem inconceivable.

1228.name: Sistermon Ciel
1228.profile: A Digimon wearing a veil modeled after a mouse, it is Sistermon Blanc's elder sister as well as the twin sister of Noir. Instead of traveling together with Noir and Blanc, it roams around the Digital World investigating unusual phenomena and reports its findings to Gankoomon. Despite its gentle personality, it is strong-willed and popular with the Digimon residing in the places it visits. While it is friendly and leads a peaceful life by day, by night it turns into an assassin who hunts down any troublemakers it receives word of. It has a cherished sword named Shirotsume-Ichimonji, and its Signature Move is cutting down the enemy without making a sound (Shirotsume-Ichimonji-giri). Not only that, it also utilizes various assassination techniques such as rapid-throwing the two knives it hides within its sleeves (Byakusai), and luring the enemy in until they let their guard down, then stabbing them in their vitals at close range using the knives planted on its feet (Tohhou).

1229.name: Sistermon Ciel (Awake)
1229.profile: Another form of Sistermon Ciel that has awakened. Wearing the wimple causes the Holy Stigma to appear on its abdomen. Its cherished sword, the "Shirotsume-Ichimonji", harbors light within its blade, and becomes sharper with each swing. It displays elegant swordsmanship in lockstep with the radiance of its cherished sword, and the moment light overflows from its sword is precisely when it turns into a sword dance that fascinates those who see it.

1230.name: Sistermon Noir
1230.profile: A nun Digimon wearing a klobuk shaped like the head of a black cat, it has a sisterly relationship with Sistermon Blanc. It breaks the ice with its extremely cheerful personality and innocent behavior. It was charged with Hackmon's care by Gankoomon, and is training Hackmon while accompanying Gankoomon on its journey. However, Sistermon Noir is working half for training, half for fun, and will point its guns and laugh even while admitting that Hackmon is sad. A long time ago, in its previous life, it was out on the streets with its younger sister Blanc, but they were saved by Gankoomon just as they were going to collapse from exhaustion. It carries guns called "Anthony" in its hands, and for its Special Moves it has the random firing of its "Mickey Bullet", rapidly firing the bullets from both in a straight line (Bless Fire), and furthermore, its "Grand Sister Cruz" which matches its movements with its younger sister and brings down the opponent.

1231.name: Sistermon Noir (Awake)
1231.profile: Another form of Sistermon Noir. Wearing the wimple on its head causes the Holy Stigma to appear on its chest, awakening its power. Its keenness has risen due the feral power drawn out by its awakening, and it brings down the enemy with a stooped-over stance.

1232.name: Skadimon
1232.profile: An Ice-Snow Digimon that rules over "Thrymheimr", a small, snow country somewhere in the snowy mountains. It appears to be a Digimon in the form of a giant snowman, but most of it resembles a powered suit made of ice. Skadimon's true form is the adorable fairy-like Digimon sitting inside the snow globe on its head.    Snow is always falling gently inside the globe, but when Skadimon fights or gets angry, its true form disappears from sight due to the blizzard. Thrymheimr is a small country where many Digimon that inhabit cold regions live, and is surrounded by ice shaped just like a snow globe. As with its head, the globe is a custom-made, solid ice wall created using Skadimon's abilities, and protects the inhabitants by blocking intruders.     When an enemy invades, it waves its stick to freely control snow and ice, and conjure various things to intercept them.     Its Special Moves are summoning a gigantic snow hand to beat down the enemy (Snow Swatter), and launching a large quantity of snowman-shaped missiles while skating with its ice skates (Snowman's Dance). When it reaches the peak of its anger, the globe on its head will break, and it unleashes its "Raging Avalanche", in which it engulfs the opponent in a avalanche that releases a huge amount of snow. Although the globe can easily regenerate, exposing its true form to danger is done as a last resort.

1235.name: Skull Knightmon
1235.profile: An elder brother who exchanged cups of brotherhood with Deadly Axemon. As a knight that excels in cunning, its behavior is based on its policy, "Those who are knights must fight. Even more importantly than fighting, they must win," and it places great importance on attaining a victorious outcome at any rate. In order to achieve that, it will unabashedly use all means, no matter how underhanded. It specializes in combat that capitalizes on the size of its body, and the manner in which it dives at the opponent's chest, swinging its "Spear Needle", shows off actions one would not expect from a knight that has forgotten its pride.

1239.name: Skull Knightmon(Big Axe Mode)
1239.profile: Deadly Axemon's "Pulverization-armament Mode", which exploits its sturdy body to be transformed into a weapon.    That battleaxe, larger than an ordinary Digimon's body, exhibits more than enough weight and stiffness to pulverize everything. It can not only be wielded by Skull Knightmon, but can also attack autonomously as a living weapon, displaying its well-coordinated combination.    Its Special Moves are charging with the "Big Axe" held forward (Axe Rider), and swinging the "Big Axe" too quickly to catch with the eyes (Storm Axe).

1240.name: Skull Knightmon(Cavalier Mode)
1240.profile: The "Assault Mode" in which Skull Knightmon is mounted on Deadly Axemon. Its main purpose is for getting close to the opponent by speeding like a bullet, defying all obstacles.    With its "Kiba Braver" it cuts the opponent apart as it charges at them, and after that, Deadly Axemon transforms into "Pulverization-armament Mode" to fight joined with Skull Knightmon. If the progress of a battle becomes unfavorable it changes back into "Assault Mode" and hastily retreats from the battlefield.    Deadly Axemon, who possesses limitless stamina, does not tire, so it can repeat this process without accident, and for a short while Deadly Axemon's way of fighting is more feared on the battlefield than Skull Knightmon's.

1243.name: Skull Mammon (X-Antibody)
1243.profile: An Undead Digimon that was a Mammon, revived from ancient times, that continued to battle with Virus-species Digimon, resulting in its whole body being eaten away by a virus, leaving nothing but bones. Its survival instinct as a Vaccine is strong even in death, and in order to continue battling, it has lost all emotion and intelligence aside from its resolve to exterminate Viruses. The Digicore shining within its chest is undamaged, so it is able to maintain its vital functions even though its body has become nothing but bones, but if the bare Digicore is struck, then Skull Mammon would probably be at the edge of death. Its Special Move is rapidly spinning and then hurling one of its vertebra (Spiral Bone).    The effect on Skull Mammon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    Having continued to battle despite turning to bones, all that awaited it was actual death, but only its skeleton started to grow due to the influence of the X-Antibody. It stands completely on two legs, and its forelimbs have changed to being claw-shaped to tear up the enemy. Its skull developed abnormally and now has gigantic horns, becoming powerful weapons that inflict heavy damage to the enemy when it charges at them. It acquired its "Giant Crush Bone", where it rapidly spins the gigantic horns on its skull and charges, smashing the enemy to pieces.

1245.name: Slash Angemon
1245.profile: A Power Digimon that commands the Powers and cuts through the vanguard in battle. As it persists in justice, it does not fear death. Along with the blades of its metal wings and hands, its entire body has gained a razor-sharp appearance, and it is surely an Angel Warrior created in order to battle wicked beings. Its Signature Move is "Holy Espada". Its Special Move is charging at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body (Heaven's Ripper).

1247.name: Sleipmon
1247.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's guardians, the "Royal Knights". While most of the Royal Knights are Human Digimon, it has a bestial silhouette which could be called bizarre. Its whole body is clad in an armor of the "Red Digizoid" which boasts great defensive power, so even Ultimate Digimon are unlikely to be able to easily damage Sleipmon. Its six legs possess unsurpassed mobility, and it is capable of instantaneous, high-speed movements that its thick build would not suggest. Sleipmon acts as a guardian of the super-ancient ruins which sleep below the thick ice of the Digital World's north pole, since it is said that essential program data which concerns the creation of Digimon is sealed within these ruins. Its Special Moves are incandescent arrows of light fired from the sacred crossbow Múspellsheimr held in its left hand (Bifröst), and using the sacred shield Niflheimr in its right hand to lower the temperature of its climate and generate a blizzard (Odin's Breath).

1248.name: Sleipmon (X-Antibody)
1248.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's guardians, the "Royal Knights". While most of the Royal Knights are Human Digimon, it has a bestial silhouette which could be called bizarre. Its whole body is clad in an armor of the "Red Digizoid" which boasts great defensive power, so even Ultimate Digimon are unlikely to be able to easily damage Sleipmon. Its six legs possess unsurpassed mobility, and it is capable of instantaneous, high-speed movements that its thick build would not suggest. Sleipmon acts as a guardian of the super-ancient ruins which sleep below the thick ice of the Digital World's north pole, since it is said that essential program data which concerns the creation of Digimon is sealed within these ruins.    The effect on Sleipmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody    In addition to its six legs it had previously, it now possesses four arms after transformation, removing any delay between loading and firing and thus allowing it to shoot continuously while moving at instantaneous high-speed.    Its Special Move is firing light arrows enveloped in hellfire that burn everything to cinders from its "Kyūkyoku Sendokyū Einherjar", fused from the wings on its back (Surtr Brander). In addition, its "Niflheimr Arrest", absolute zero cold air generated by the sacred "Niflheimr" shields equipped on each pair of its arms, freezes the surface of the ground and brings all vital functions to a complete halt.

1253.name: Solarmon
1253.profile: A Machine Digimon that appears to be a rare species of mechanical Digimon. Some researchers say that it might be a mutation of Hagurumon, but the truth is a mystery. Due to its "Computer Kernel" generating heat, its body has become hot enough to cause burns. Its Special Move is launching a gear that generates intense heat to scorch the enemy (Shiny Ring).

1255.name: Sorcerimon
1255.profile: Wizarmon's comrade who came from "Witchelny", the Digital World of another dimension.
